      WHEN ep.avg_gap < -0.5 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END as performance_risk,
    CASE 
      WHEN et.level <= 2 AND et.tenure_years >= 5 THEN 'High'
      WHEN et.level <= 3 AND et.tenure_years >= 7 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END as stagnation_risk,
    CASE 
      WHEN et.tenure_years >= 8 THEN 'High'
      WHEN et.tenure_years >= 5 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END as tenure_risk,
    CASE 
      WHEN etr.recent_trend < -0.3 THEN 'Declining'
      WHEN etr.recent_trend < 0 THEN 'Slightly Declining'
      WHEN etr.recent_trend = 0 THEN 'Stable'
      WHEN etr.recent_trend > 0 THEN 'Improving'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END as trend_category
  FROM employee_tenure et
  LEFT JOIN employee_performance ep ON ep.employee_id = et.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN cert_expiring_2027 ce ON ce.employee_id = et.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN employee_trend etr ON etr.employee_id = et.employee_id
  WHERE ep.avg_score IS NOT NULL
)

  er.employee_id,
  er.name,
  er.job_title,
  er.level,
  er.hired_on,
  er.region_id,

  er.avg_score,
  er.avg_target,
  er.avg_gap,
  er.performance_risk,
  er.stagnation_risk,
  er.tenure_risk,
  er.trend_category,
  er.recent_trend,
  er.certs_expiring_2027,
  er.expiring_certs,
  CASE 
    WHEN er.performance_risk = 'High' AND er.stagnation_risk = 'High' THEN 'Very High'
    WHEN er.performance_risk = 'High' OR er.stagnation_risk = 'High' THEN 'High'
    WHEN er.performance_risk = 'Medium' OR er.stagnation_risk = 'Medium' OR er.tenure_risk = 'High' OR er.trend_category IN ('Declining', 'Slightly Declining') THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN er.certs_expiring_2027 > 0 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END as attrition_risk
FROM employee_risk er
WHERE

    WHEN er.performance_risk = 'High' AND er.stagnation_risk = 'High' THEN 'Very High'
    WHEN er.performance_risk = 'High' OR er.stagnation_risk = 'High' THEN 'High'
    WHEN er.performance_risk = 'Medium' OR er.stagnation_risk = 'Medium' OR er.tenure_risk = 'High' OR er.trend_category IN ('Declining', 'Slightly Declining') THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN er.certs_expiring_2027 > 0 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END IN ('Very High', 'High', 'Medium')

    WHEN er.performance_risk = 'High' OR er.stagnation_risk = 'High' THEN 2

WITH latest_assessments AS (
  SELECT a.employee_id, e.name, e.job_title, a.score as actual_score
  FROM skills.assessments a
  JOIN skills.employees e ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id
  WHERE a.skill_id = 2
    AND a.cycle_id = (SELECT MAX(cycle_id) FROM skills.assessments WHERE skill_id = 2)
    AND e.left_on IS NULL
),
targets AS (
  SELECT job_title, target_score
  FROM skills.role_targets
  WHERE skill_id = 2
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    la.employee_id,
    la.name,
    la.job_title,
    la.actual_score,
    t.target_score,
    (t.target_score - la.actual_score) as skill_gap
  FROM latest_assessments la
  JOIN targets t ON la.job_title = t.job_title
),
overall AS (
  SELECT 
    'Overall' as breakdown,
    COUNT(*) as employee_count,
    ROUND(AVG(skill_gap)::numeric, 2) as avg_skill_gap,
    MIN(skill_gap) as min_gap,
    MAX(skill_gap) as max_gap,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap > 0) as employees_with_gap,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap = 0) as employees_at_target,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap < 0) as employees_above_target,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap > 0) / COUNT(*), 1) as pct_with_gap,
    0 as sort_order
  FROM gaps
),
by_role AS (
  SELECT 
    'By Role: ' || job_title as breakdown,
    COUNT(*) as employee_count,
    ROUND(AVG(skill_gap)::numeric, 2) as avg_skill_gap,
    MIN(skill_gap) as min_gap,
    MAX(skill_gap) as max_gap,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap > 0) as employees_with_gap,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap = 0) as employees_at_target,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap < 0) as employees_above_target,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE skill_gap > 0) / COUNT(*), 1) as pct_with_gap,
    1 as sort_order
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY job_title
)
SELECT 
  breakdown,
  employee_count,
  avg_skill_gap,
  min_gap,
  max_gap,
  employees_with_gap,
  employees_at_target,
  employees_above_target,
  pct_with_gap
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM overall
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM by_role
) combined
ORDER BY sort_order, avg_skill_gap DESC
